Should detect context and copy the most relevant item, or show a menu if multiple options available.

title: Improve file list scrolling UX
description:
## Current Behavior
- Scrolling down moves the list, keeping cursor position on screen
- Scrolling back up immediately scrolls the list, leaving cursor at bottom of visible area

## Expected Behavior
- Scrolling down: scroll list only when cursor would go below visible area
- Scrolling up: do NOT scroll until cursor reaches top visible item
- Only scroll when cursor would move off-screen (either direction)

This is the standard 'scroll when needed' pattern used by most file managers and editors. The viewport should stay still while the cursor moves within visible bounds, only scrolling when the cursor would otherwise go off-screen.

## Files to investigate
- src/app/mod.rs (handle_key for up/down)
- scroll_offset logic
close_reason: Scroll offset now properly maintained during navigation
